## Why look at embeddings? {#intro-gap}

- Evaluation benchmarks focus on model performance [after fine-tuning]{.hl}.
- There is limited understanding of the benefits and limitations of different [pre-training strategies]{.hl}.
- Exploring the [embedding space]{.hl} can complement benchmarking on downstream tasks.
- Interactive exploration, visualization, and granular analysis helps us address [why]{.hl} models differ in performance
